topics.title: Articles 41 & 44 — President
topics.summary: Article 41 intikhab aur minimum umar 45; Article 44 normal muddat 5 saal.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution, 21 November 2025: Articles 41 and 44

topics.title: Article 50 — Parliament
topics.summary: Parliament mein President aur do Houses shamil hain: National Assembly aur Senate.

topics.title: Article 51 — Voting age
topics.summary: Vote ki minimum umar 18 saal hai.

topics.title: Article 58 — National Assembly dissolution
topics.summary: PM ke mashware par Assembly ki dissolution: 48 ghante wala rule yaad rakhein.

topics.title: Article 59 — Senate seats and term
topics.summary: Senate ki 96 seats: har soobay ki 23 aur Federal Capital ki 4. Senator ki muddat 6 saal hoti hai; Senate khud dissolve nahin hota.

references.title: Senate of Pakistan — House of Federation and current composition

topics.title: Article 60 — Senate Chairman
topics.summary: Senate Chairman ki muddat 3 saal hai.

topics.title: Article 62 — Parliamentary membership age
topics.summary: Membership ki minimum umar: National Assembly 25, Senate 30 saal.

topics.title: Articles 153 & 154 — Council of Common Interests
topics.summary: CCI mein PM, chaar Chief Ministers aur PM ke nominate kiye hue Federal Government ke 3 members hote hain. PM chair karta hai; meeting kam az kam har 90 din mein hoti hai.

references.title: Council of Common Interests — Constitutional provisions, Articles 153 and 154

topics.title: Article 156 — National Economic Council
topics.summary: PM ki sarbarahi mein NEC mulki maeeshat aur taraqqi ke mansubon ka jaiza leta hai.

topics.title: Article 175B — Federal Constitutional Court
topics.summary: 27th Amendment ko 13 November 2025 ko assent mila aur FCC bana. Justice Amin-ud-Din Khan ne pehle Chief Justice ke taur par 14 November 2025 ko oath liya.

references.title: National Assembly — Twenty-Seventh Amendment Act, 13 November 2025
Federal Constitutional Court — First Chief Justice profile

topics.title: Article 177 — Supreme Court judge qualifications
topics.summary: Advocacy route: High Court mein 15 saal aur Supreme Court advocate hona bhi zaroori.

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0170-Q037-SRC: Yeh Article 177 ki advocacy wali qualification hai; High Court judge wala alag rasta bhi maujood hai.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0170-Q037-SIM: Supreme Court advocate hona, High Court advocacy ke 15 saal walay rastay ki izafi shart hai.

topics.title: Article 195 — High Court judge retirement
topics.summary: High Court judge ki retirement umar 62 saal hai.

topics.title: Articles 203C & 203D — Federal Shariat Court
topics.summary: 203C court ki tashkeel; 203D qanun ki Islami ahkaam se mutabiqat ke jaizay se mutalliq hai.

references.title: National Assembly — Constitution, 21 November 2025: Federal Shariat Court chapter and 1980 insertion notes

topics.title: Article 215 — Chief Election Commissioner term
topics.summary: CEC ki muqarrar muddat 5 saal hai.

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0032-Q040-SRC: Muqarrar term 5 saal hai; Article 215 mein successor ke ohda sambhalne tak jari rehne ki shart bhi hai.

topics.title: Article 228 — Council of Islamic Ideology
topics.summary: CII ka poora naam Council of Islamic Ideology hai.

topics.title: Article 239 — Constitutional amendment majority
topics.summary: Tarmeem ke liye har House ki kul membership ka do-tehai vote chahiye.

topics.title: Article 242 — Public Service Commissions
topics.summary: Article 242 PSCs ki qanuni tashkeel se mutalliq hai; FPSC ka mutalliq qanun FPSC Ordinance 1977 hai.

references.title: Federal Public Service Commission — FPSC Ordinance 1977

topics.title: Article 245 — Armed Forces and civil power
topics.summary: Federal Government ki hidayat par Armed Forces qanun ke tehat civil power ki madad karti hain.

topics.title: Former Article 58(2)(b) — Historical dissolution power
topics.summary: Yeh purani presidential dissolution power ke MCQs hain. 1985 ka arrangement, 2002 LFO aur 2003 ki 17th Amendment ke baad 2010 ki 18th Amendment ne is power ko hata diya; ise aaj ka Article 58 na samjhein.

references.title: National Assembly — Parliamentary history: 1985 dissolution power
Sindh Judicial Academy — Seventeenth Amendment text and LFO validation
National Assembly — Constitution, 21 November 2025: substituted Article 58

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0006-Q021-SRC: Historical sawal: yeh former Article 58(2)(b) ki power thi, maujooda Article 58 ki unrestricted power nahin.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0002-Q022-SRC: Tareekhi wazahat: asal bahali LFO 2002 mein hui; 17th Amendment 2003 ne us arrangement ko validate aur modify kiya. Is sawal mein poochhi gai 2010 ki removal 18th Amendment se hui.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0002-Q022-SIM: Bank ka jawab 17th Amendment hai. Zyada theek chronology: LFO 2002 mein bahali, phir 17th Amendment 2003 mein validation aur modification; dono ko aik hi tareekh ka qadam na samjhein.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0018-Q037-SRC: Yeh 1985 ke arrangement ka sawal hai; is power ko current constitutional rule na samjhein.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0018-Q037-SIM: 1985 ki 8th Amendment se mutalliq historical sawal; former Article 58(2)(b) ab maujood nahin.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0016-Q044-SRC: Yeh 2010 ki 18th Amendment ke asar ka historical sawal hai.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0016-Q044-SIM: Yeh 2010 ki 18th Amendment aur parliamentary nizam ki taraf ikhtiyarat ki muntaqili ka sawal hai.

topics.title: Articles 184 & 185 — 2024 questions, 2025 changes
topics.summary: Neechay ke dono sawal khas 21 October 2024 ke matn par hain. 2025 ki 27th Amendment ne Article 184 omit kiya; FCC ki original jurisdiction Article 175E mein hai. Article 185 omit nahin hua, lekin us ka matn badla.

references.title: National Assembly — Historical Constitution as amended to 21 October 2024
National Assembly — Twenty-Seventh Amendment Act 2025: Articles 175E, 175F, 184 and 185

questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0159-Q043-SRC: Sirf 21 October 2024 ke historical matn ke liye Article 184(3) jawab hai. 2025 mein Article 184 omit ho chuka; FCC ki original jurisdiction Article 175E mein hai. Is purane sawal ko current Supreme Court power na samjhein.
questionNotes.ADV2E102-U0159-Q043-SIM: Sawal 21 October 2024 ke matn par hai. Article 185 ab bhi Supreme Court ki appellate jurisdiction se mutalliq hai, magar 2025 mein matn amend hua aur Article 175F ki shart shamil hui; Article 185 omit nahin hua.
